visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor retail environment, a clerk dressed in a grey utility vest stands behind a black textured counter. A square light-blue box featuring a white cartoon character and the text '微疼' is the central focus. The clerk is seen organizing small paper slips while another person's hands rest on the table. (2) The customer's hands enter the frame, reaching towards the opening of the box to select a lottery ticket. The clerk observes while holding a small handheld device. Background elements include shelves with merchandise, various decorative stickers, and a large pink salt lamp on a shelf. (3) The customer brings the small square ticket close to the camera, peeling away the adhesive layer to reveal the prize letter. A security camera and overhead shop signage are visible in the blurred background. (4) After revealing the 'E' prize on the ticket, the clerk retrieves a white, character-shaped plush toy sealed in a clear plastic bag from beneath the counter and hands it to the customer, who accepts it with both hands while moving the prize into full view.
